name: Disable Aggregation
description: Disables JS and CSS aggregation for authenticated users.
project_description:
Sometimes, when aggregation is enabled, there are errors for authenticated users. This module solves that problem by disabling authentication.

 Features 
 When editing nodes, some authenticated users get JavaScript errors that are caused by aggregated JS files. By disabling aggregation, the errors will not occur.

 Similar projects 
 Advanced CSS/JS Aggregation , which has not been updated since 2023.

 Supporting this Module 
 Collaborators are actively being sought. If you think you can help add a UI and/or additional functionality (e.g., aggregation enabling/disabling depending on user role), please reach out.
